lines.gurmukhi: ਇਹ ਬਿਧਿ ਸੁਨਿ ਕੈ ਜਾਟਰੋ ਉਠਿ ਭਗਤੀ ਲਾਗਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: ih bidh sun kai jaataro uth bhagatee laagaa ||
lines.translation: Hearing this, Dhanna the Jaat applied himself to devotional worship.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਿਲੇ ਪ੍ਰਤਖਿ ਗੁਸਾਈਆ ਧੰਨਾ ਵਡਭਾਗਾ ॥੪॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: mile pratakh gusaaeeaa dha(n)naa vadabhaagaa ||4||2||
lines.translation: The Lord of the Universe met him personally; Dhanna was so very blessed. ||4||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਰੇ ਚਿਤ ਚੇਤਸਿ ਕੀ ਨ ਦਯਾਲ ਦਮੋਦਰ ਬਿਬਹਿ ਨ ਜਾਨਸਿ ਕੋਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: re chit chetas kee na dayaal damodar bibahi na jaanas koee ||
lines.translation: O my consciousness, why don't you remain conscious of the Merciful Lord? How can you recognize any other?

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੇ ਧਾਵਹਿ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੰਡ ਖੰਡ ਕਉ ਕਰਤਾ ਕਰੈ ਸੁ ਹੋਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: je dhaavahi brahama(n)d kha(n)d kau karataa karai s hoee ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: You may run around the whole universe, but that alone happens which the Creator Lord does. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਨਨੀ ਕੇਰੇ ਉਦਰ ਉਦਕ ਮਹਿ ਪਿੰਡੁ ਕੀਆ ਦਸ ਦੁਆਰਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: jananee kere udar udak mahi pi(n)d keeaa das duaaraa ||
lines.translation: In the water of the mother's womb, He fashioned the body with ten gates.

lines.gurmukhi: ਦੇਇ ਅਹਾਰੁ ਅਗਨਿ ਮਹਿ ਰਾਖੈ ਐਸਾ ਖਸਮੁ ਹਮਾਰਾ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: dei ahaar agan mahi raakhai aisaa khasam hamaaraa ||1||
lines.translation: He gives it sustenance, and preserves it in fire - such is my Lord and Master. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਕੁੰਮੀ ਜਲ ਮਾਹਿ ਤਨ ਤਿਸੁ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਪੰਖ ਖੀਰੁ ਤਿਨ ਨਾਹੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: ku(n)mee jal maahi tan tis baahar pa(n)kh kheer tin naahee ||
lines.translation: The mother turtle is in the water, and her babies are out of the water. She has no wings to protect them, and no milk to feed them.

lines.gurmukhi: ਪੂਰਨ ਪਰਮਾਨੰਦ ਮਨੋਹਰ ਸਮਝਿ ਦੇਖੁ ਮਨ ਮਾਹੀ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: pooran paramaana(n)d manohar samajh dekh man maahee ||2||
lines.translation: The Perfect Lord, the embodiment of supreme bliss, the Fascinating Lord takes care of them. See this, and understand it in your mind||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਾਖਣਿ ਕੀਟੁ ਗੁਪਤੁ ਹੋਇ ਰਹਤਾ ਤਾ ਚੋ ਮਾਰਗੁ ਨਾਹੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: paakhan keet gupat hoi rahataa taa cho maarag naahee ||
lines.translation: The worm lies hidden under the stone - there is no way for him to escape.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਹੈ ਧੰਨਾ ਪੂਰਨ ਤਾਹੂ ਕੋ ਮਤ ਰੇ ਜੀਅ ਡਰਾਂਹੀ ॥੩॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: kahai dha(n)naa pooran taahoo ko mat re jee daraa(n)hee ||3||3||
lines.translation: Says Dhanna, the Perfect Lord takes care of him. Fear not, O my soul. ||3||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਸਾ ਸੇਖ ਫਰੀਦ ਜੀਉ ਕੀ ਬਾਣੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: aasaa sekh phareed jeeu kee baanee ||
lines.translation: Aasaa, The Word Of Shaykh Fareed Jee:

lines.gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
lines.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

lines.gurmukhi: ਦਿਲਹੁ ਮੁਹਬਤਿ ਜਿੰਨੑ ਸੇਈ ਸਚਿਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: dilahu muhabat ji(n)nh seee sachiaa ||
lines.translation: They alone are true, whose love for God is deep and heart-felt.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਨੑ ਮਨਿ ਹੋਰੁ ਮੁਖਿ ਹੋਰੁ ਸਿ ਕਾਂਢੇ ਕਚਿਆ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: jinh man hor mukh hor s kaa(n)dhe kachiaa ||1||
lines.translation: Those who have one thing in their heart, and something else in their mouth, are judged to be false. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਰਤੇ ਇਸਕ ਖੁਦਾਇ ਰੰਗਿ ਦੀਦਾਰ ਕੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: rate isak khudaai ra(n)g deedaar ke ||
lines.translation: Those who are imbued with love for the Lord, are delighted by His Vision.

lines.gurmukhi: ਵਿਸਰਿਆ ਜਿਨੑ ਨਾਮੁ ਤੇ ਭੁਇ ਭਾਰੁ ਥੀਏ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: visariaa jinh naam te bhui bhaar theee ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: Those who forget the Naam, the Name of the Lord, are a burden on the earth. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਪਿ ਲੀਏ ਲੜਿ ਲਾਇ ਦਰਿ ਦਰਵੇਸ ਸੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: aap leee laR laai dar daraves se ||
lines.translation: Those whom the Lord attaches to the hem of His robe, are the true dervishes at His Door.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਿਨ ਧੰਨੁ ਜਣੇਦੀ ਮਾਉ ਆਏ ਸਫਲੁ ਸੇ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: tin dha(n)n janedee maau aae saphal se ||2||
lines.translation: Blessed are the mothers who gave birth to them, and fruitful is their coming into the world. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਰਵਦਗਾਰ ਅਪਾਰ ਅਗਮ ਬੇਅੰਤ ਤੂ ॥
lines.transliteration: paravadagaar apaar agam bea(n)t too ||
lines.translation: O Lord, Sustainer and Cherisher, You are infinite, unfathomable and endless.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਨਾ ਪਛਾਤਾ ਸਚੁ ਚੁੰਮਾ ਪੈਰ ਮੂੰ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: jinaa pachhaataa sach chu(n)maa pair moo(n) ||3||
lines.translation: Those who recognize the True Lord - I kiss their feet. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਤੇਰੀ ਪਨਹ ਖੁਦਾਇ ਤੂ ਬਖਸੰਦਗੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: teree panah khudaai too bakhasa(n)dagee ||
lines.translation: I seek Your Protection - You are the Forgiving Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੇਖ ਫਰੀਦੈ ਖੈਰੁ ਦੀਜੈ ਬੰਦਗੀ ॥੪॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: sekh phareedai khair deejai ba(n)dagee ||4||1||
lines.translation: Please, bless Shaykh Fareed with the bounty of Your meditative worship. ||4||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਸਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: aasaa ||
lines.translation: Aasaa:

lines.gurmukhi: ਬੋਲੈ ਸੇਖ ਫਰੀਦੁ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਅਲਹ ਲਗੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: bolai sekh phareed piaare alah lage ||
lines.translation: Says Shaykh Fareed, O my dear friend, attach yourself to the Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਇਹੁ ਤਨੁ ਹੋਸੀ ਖਾਕ ਨਿਮਾਣੀ ਗੋਰ ਘਰੇ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: ihu tan hosee khaak nimaanee gor ghare ||1||
lines.translation: This body shall turn to dust, and its home shall be a neglected graveyard. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਜੁ ਮਿਲਾਵਾ ਸੇਖ ਫਰੀਦ ਟਾਕਿਮ ਕੂੰਜੜੀਆ ਮਨਹੁ ਮਚਿੰਦੜੀਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: aaj milaavaa sekh phareed taakim koo(n)jaReeaa manahu machi(n)daReeaa ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: You can meet the Lord today, O Shaykh Fareed, if you restrain your bird-like desires which keep your mind in turmoil. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੇ ਜਾਣਾ ਮਰਿ ਜਾਈਐ ਘੁਮਿ ਨ ਆਈਐ ॥
lines.transliteration: je jaanaa mar jaaeeai ghum na aaeeai ||
lines.translation: If I had known that I was to die, and not return again,

lines.gurmukhi: ਝੂਠੀ ਦੁਨੀਆ ਲਗਿ ਨ ਆਪੁ ਵਞਾਈਐ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: jhoothee duneeaa lag na aap vanjaaeeai ||2||
lines.translation: I would not have ruined myself by clinging to the world of falsehood. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਬੋਲੀਐ ਸਚੁ ਧਰਮੁ ਝੂਠੁ ਨ ਬੋਲੀਐ ॥
lines.transliteration: boleeai sach dharam jhooth na boleeai ||
lines.translation: So speak the Truth, in righteousness, and do not speak falsehood.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਗੁਰੁ ਦਸੈ ਵਾਟ ਮੁਰੀਦਾ ਜੋਲੀਐ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: jo gur dasai vaat mureedaa joleeai ||3||
lines.translation: The disciple ought to travel the route, pointed out by the Guru. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਛੈਲ ਲੰਘੰਦੇ ਪਾਰਿ ਗੋਰੀ ਮਨੁ ਧੀਰਿਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: chhail la(n)gha(n)de paar goree man dheeriaa ||
lines.translation: Seeing the youths being carried across, the hearts of the beautiful young soul-brides are encouraged.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕੰਚਨ ਵੰਨੇ ਪਾਸੇ ਕਲਵਤਿ ਚੀਰਿਆ ॥੪॥
lines.transliteration: ka(n)chan va(n)ne paase kalavat cheeriaa ||4||
lines.translation: Those who side with the glitter of gold, are cut down with a saw. ||4||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੇਖ ਹੈਯਾਤੀ ਜਗਿ ਨ ਕੋਈ ਥਿਰੁ ਰਹਿਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: sekh haiyaatee jag na koee thir rahiaa ||
lines.translation: O Shaykh, no one's life is permanent in this world.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਸੁ ਆਸਣਿ ਹਮ ਬੈਠੇ ਕੇਤੇ ਬੈਸਿ ਗਇਆ ॥੫॥
lines.transliteration: jis aasan ham baithe kete bais gaiaa ||5||
lines.translation: That seat, upon which we now sit - many others sat on it and have since departed. ||5||

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਤਿਕ ਕੂੰਜਾਂ ਚੇਤਿ ਡਉ ਸਾਵਣਿ ਬਿਜੁਲੀਆਂ ॥
lines.transliteration: katik koo(n)jaa(n) chet dau saavan bijuleeaa(n) ||
lines.translation: As the swallows appear in the month of Katik, forest fires in the month of Chayt, and lightning in Saawan,

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੀਆਲੇ ਸੋਹੰਦੀਆਂ ਪਿਰ ਗਲਿ ਬਾਹੜੀਆਂ ॥੬॥
lines.transliteration: seeaale soha(n)deeaa(n) pir gal baahaReeaa(n) ||6||
lines.translation: and as the bride's arms adorn her husband's neck in winter;||6||

lines.gurmukhi: ਚਲੇ ਚਲਣਹਾਰ ਵਿਚਾਰਾ ਲੇਇ ਮਨੋ ॥
lines.transliteration: chale chalanahaar vichaaraa lei mano ||
lines.translation: Just so, the transitory human bodies pass away. Reflect upon this in your mind.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੰਢੇਦਿਆਂ ਛਿਅ ਮਾਹ ਤੁੜੰਦਿਆ ਹਿਕੁ ਖਿਨੋ ॥੭॥
lines.transliteration: ga(n)dhediaa(n) chhi maah tuRa(n)diaa hik khino ||7||
lines.translation: It takes six months to form the body, but it breaks in an instant. ||7||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਮੀ ਪੁਛੈ ਅਸਮਾਨ ਫਰੀਦਾ ਖੇਵਟ ਕਿੰਨਿ ਗਏ ॥
lines.transliteration: jimee puchhai asamaan phareedaa khevat ki(n)n gae ||
lines.translation: O Fareed, the earth asks the sky, "Where have the boatmen gone?"

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਾਲਣ ਗੋਰਾਂ ਨਾਲਿ ਉਲਾਮੇ ਜੀਅ ਸਹੇ ॥੮॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: jaalan goraa(n) naal ulaame jee sahe ||8||2||
lines.translation: Some have been cremated, and some lie in their graves; their souls are suffering rebukes. ||8||2||
